scope: Four real Echoes.NET cold tabs only, not a full player scenario
method: Each tab visited once after new MainWindow/YaShell startup. Shared transition prepared manually while frame clock paused. Visible widget geometries compared with five subsequent event-loop drains. Preparation times include those five drains and are not FPS measurements.

checks.late_delete_failure: Initial test exposed PyQt raising AttributeError after QObject destruction; guard corrected and the affected case passed on rerun.

limitations: Cold native hardware discovery now occurs in a worker. First settings construction is still appreciable. Elapsed times include unrelated event handling and should not be presented as a controlled before/after speedup or live display FPS.

settings_profile.interpretation: Visible switch accounts for the cold cost; incoming capture/deep settlement is much smaller. Import/bootstrap time appears in the profile, but exact imported module names and GUI GIL ownership were not established. No subprocess or further native rewrite introduced.

final_revision.native_discovery: isolated helper process, no GUI/DSP/codec import for settings
final_revision.settings_geometry_recheck: passed, no visible changes after capture
final_revision.diagnostic: A discovery-disabled scoped probe exposed a 1.7s synchronous net_voice import; it was removed. Earlier preparation totals are historical and are not final latency/FPS claims.
